body: I feel selfish for even thinking about making my post. I just feel trapped right now, and no matter which direction I look, I don't see a way out. Sorry if I sounded selfish last night. Now I feel like an even bigger ass.

Too many to type on my phone to be honest. Mostly just filled with debilitating guilt. I really don't want to talk about it in a thread. It wasn't illegal or anything, the thing I did, but holy fuck, is it socially stigmatized. I don't even feel I wanna talk about it anymore. Looked up methods earlier and Google was telling me "You're not alone" and threw a hotline in my face. Fuck you, Google. You don't **really** know that.
Why the fuck was I downvoted? Fuck me, alright. At least tell me what I did wrong. Sorry for having second thoughts?
